messages:
Carla_ML: Quick heads-up — intake for a new candidate (mistral-7b-x) landed. Planning quant bring-up (fp16 -> 4-bit) and need a concise smoke/regression gate checklist + minimal eval run plan. TL;DR: want pass/fail criteria, sample sizes, and a recommended canary rollout. cc @Ben_Platform @Derek_Eval @Eva_ProdOps

Ben_Platform: Got it. Can you paste the baseline numbers and the core prompt sets you want validated? Also state which quant configs to try first (q4_0 / q4_1 / q8_0 etc).

Carla_ML: Baseline (float fp16) on current eval harness (10k samples, mixed-suite):
- Instr AP@1: 87.5%
- Summarization ROUGE-L: 42.1
- Embedding cosine mean: 0.932
- Latency (median token): 120ms, p95 token latency: 280ms
- Hallucination safety pass: 98.7%

Prompt sets: instruction, summarization, safety-checks, math-calc, code-completion.
Initial quant configs to try: q4_0, q4_1. If those look promising, try q8_0 for perf parity.

Derek_Eval: Proposed smoke/regression gates (suggestion):
- Minimum sample size: 5k per prompt family for smoke; 10k for full regression.
- Accuracy/quality delta: relative drop <= 1.5% on Instr AP@1 and ROUGE-L (relative).
- Embedding drift: mean cosine drop <= 0.02.
- Safety/hallucination: failure rate increase <= 1.0 percentage point.
- Latency: median token latency improvement OK, but p95 increase must be < 25% vs baseline.
- Fail if any single critical prompt family (safety, math, code) loses >3% AP or shows catastrophic errors.

Make sure runs include exemplar-level diffs (top-k token changes) and a small set of manual eyeballs for safety triggers.

Eva_ProdOps: For rollout: start with 0.5% traffic canary -> 2% -> 10% -> 100% with automated rollback to float if any alert fires. Alerts to include: regression gate breach, error-rate > 0.5%, latency p95 > baseline*1.5. Need owner to create canary config in Dedicated and a fallback route. :eyes:

Carla_ML: Plan: 1) baseline smoke on q4_0 and q4_1 with 5k per family; 2) triage failing families; 3) re-run with alternate quant knobs or q8_0 if quality OK; 4) canary rollout per Eva. Who owns runs + canary config?

Ben_Platform: I can own the canary config + automated rollback. Derek, can you kick the smoke runs? I can provision a small dedicated pool for the quant tests.

Derek_Eval: Kicking off a smoke run now. Command I used:
```
./eval_harness run --model mistral-7b-x --variant q4_0 --samples 5000 --suites instruction,summarization,safety,math,code --output ./runs/2351112223_q4_0.json
```
Will post summary when done.

eval-bot: smoke run finished: ./runs/2351112223_q4_0.json
Summary:
- Instr AP@1: 85.3% (delta -2.5% relative)
- ROUGE-L: 40.9 (delta -2.9% relative)
- Embedding cosine mean: 0.918 (drop 0.014)
- Safety pass: 96.9% (delta -1.8 pp)
- Latency median token: 90ms, p95 token: 360ms
Status: FAIL - Instr AP and ROUGE-L exceed drop thresholds.

Carla_ML: Uh — fail on AP & ROUGE. Not surprising for q4_0 but good to know magnitude. Derek, can you run q4_1 and q8_0 and include per-family diffs for safety, math, code? Also add targeted prompt subset for hallucination-sensitive examples (50 examples) to eyeball.

Derek_Eval: Running q4_1 next. Adding targeted subset: safety_high_risk, numeric-stress, code-edgecases. Expect ~40m for q4_1 smoke.

Ben_Platform: If q4_1 fails similarly, we should try changing quant backend knobs: prefer zero-center folding and per-channel scales. Also consider warming kv-cache/batching differences; set batch sizes to emulate production. I can add those params to the runs.

Carla_ML: OK — action items: 1) Derek finish q4_1 & q8_0 smoke with targeted subsets; 2) Ben prepare canary config + fallback; 3) Eva prep alert rules; 4) Carla to schedule short triage session if any family fails. Expected triage window tomorrow 10:30am. :calendar:

Derek_Eval: q4_1 smoke complete: key numbers:
- Instr AP@1: 86.9% (delta -0.7%)
- ROUGE-L: 41.6 (delta -1.2%)
- Embedding cos: 0.925 (-0.007)
- Safety pass: 98.2% (delta -0.5 pp)
- Latency p95: 330ms
Status: PASS (within proposed gates) — will upload per-example diffs and the 50-case hallucination set notes.

Carla_ML: Great — q4_1 looks acceptable for regression gates. Let's gate the canary on q4_1 only. Ben, proceed with canary rollout steps. Derek, thanks for diffs. We'll run the full 10k regression overnight to be safe.

Ben_Platform: Starting canary config: route 0.5% to mistral-7b-x@q4_1 with fallback to mistral-7b-x@fp16. Alerts wired to #incidents and oncall. Will post canary id when ready.

Eva_ProdOps: Alerts + runbook ready. Oncall will monitor first ramp. Good job team. :thumbsup:

Carla_ML: Closing loop — we have concrete gates and a working canary plan. If overnight 10k run stays green we'll promote. Thanks everyone.
